message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates daily. As of the most recent rates (around $1 ≈ £0.78 – £0.80), $20 would be roughly **£15.60 – £16.00**.  

If you need an exact figure for a specific date or transaction, you can check a reliable financial news source, a bank’s currency converter, or a dedicated currency‑conversion API.
